sourceChecks.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
sourceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEBはメラリ系譜でシメイの子としてUzzahを記す。

excludedCandidateChecks.reasonJa: Wikipedia itself distinguishes the Merarite Uzzah from the Ark-related Uzzah; no identity is shared.

profileDecisionJa: WEB 1CH6:29のUzzahはシメイの子でメラリ系譜に属する。WikipediaのUzzah記事は「Other」でこの別人を記し、1CH6:29を引用するため採用した。

wikipediaReadEvidence.title: Uzzah
wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: “Other” section, lines 132–136: explicitly distinguishes a different Uzzah, son of Shimei and a Merarite; reference 7 at lines 149–150 cites 1 Chronicles 6:29.
